goal: 用数据分析说服团队采纳你的结论

n1.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n1.line: Before we decide on the marketing budget, let us review your analysis. Have you examined all the data we collected?
n1.lineCn: 在我们决定营销预算之前,先看看你的分析。我们收集的全部数据你都看过了吗?

grammar.name: 限定词 all
grammar.note: all the data 中 all 限定可数不可数名词均可,强调"全部"范围,核查完整度。

options.text: I have examined all the data we collected, and the conclusion is clear: digital ads outperform print.
options.textCn: 我们收集的全部数据我都看过了,结论很清晰:数字广告优于印刷广告。

options.text: I have examined some of the data, but not all of it yet.
options.textCn: 我看了部分数据,但还没看完全部。

options.text: Every chart I have seen contradicts the others. I trust none of them.
options.textCn: 我看到的每张图表都相互矛盾,我谁也不信。
options.feedback: 数据存疑,组长引导排查。

n2.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n2.line: That is a bold conclusion. Can you point out the key evidence? In each of the five regions we tested, the results were identical.
n2.lineCn: 这是个大胆的结论。你能指出关键证据吗?在我们测试的五个地区中,每个地区的结果都一致。

grammar.name: 限定词 each
grammar.note: each of the five regions 中 each 强调"每一个"个体,用于逐项列举与论证。

options.text: In each of the five regions we tested, the conversion rate rose after the digital campaign.
options.textCn: 在我们测试的五个地区中,每个地区的转化率在数字活动后都上升了。

options.text: Both the click rates and the sales figures support my conclusion.
options.textCn: 点击率和销售额两个指标都支持我的结论。

options.text: The numbers are hard to read, but I have a strong feeling I am right.
options.textCn: 数字很难读,但我强烈感觉我是对的。
options.feedback: 凭感觉断言,组长追问证据。

n3.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n3.line: Half-hearted analysis cannot guide decisions. Either you finish the job, or we move on without your input.
n3.lineCn: 敷衍的分析无法指导决策。要么你完成分析,要么我们绕开你继续推进。

grammar.name: 限定词 either...or
grammar.note: either...or 提供二选一的限定,表"两者任一",语气明确、不留余地。

options.text: I will finish the analysis tonight. Neither budget will be approved without complete data.
options.textCn: 我今晚就完成分析。没有完整数据,哪个预算方案都不该批准。

options.text: Few of my colleagues trust your timelines anyway. I will finish when I can.
options.textCn: 反正没几个同事相信你的期限。我什么时候能完就什么时候。

options.text: Either way, the conclusion will not change, so why bother with the rest?
options.textCn: 无论怎样结论都不会变,何必看完剩下的?

n4.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n4.line: Conflicting charts usually mean something went wrong. Have you checked whether every source is reliable?
n4.lineCn: 图表互相矛盾通常意味着哪里出了问题。你检查过每个数据源是否可靠吗?

grammar.name: 限定词 every
grammar.note: every source 强调"每一个数据源"都要核查,与 whether 从句连用表逐一排查。

options.text: You are right. After checking every source, I found that two of them were outdated.
options.textCn: 您说得对。逐一核查每个数据源后,我发现其中两个已过时。

options.text: I have checked neither the sources nor the methods, to be honest.
options.textCn: 老实说,数据源和方法我都没核查。
options.feedback: 工作疏漏,组长严肃批评。

options.text: None of the sources are entirely reliable. That is just how data works.
options.textCn: 没有一个数据源完全可靠,数据本来就是这样的。

n5.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n5.line: Concrete evidence at last. Give us a few specific figures that convinced you to favour digital channels.
n5.lineCn: 终于有实证了。给我们几个说服你倾向数字渠道的具体数字。

grammar.name: 限定词 a few
grammar.note: a few 修饰可数名词复数,意为"几个",语气肯定,与 few(几乎没)区分。

options.text: A few figures stand out: the digital campaign reached twice as many people at half the cost.
options.textCn: 有几个数字很突出:数字活动以一半成本触达了两倍的人群。

options.text: Both figures improved, but neither of them improved dramatically.
options.textCn: 两个指标都有提升,但都不算大幅提升。

options.text: I remember the general trend. The exact numbers are somewhere in the report.
options.textCn: 我记得大致趋势,确切数字在报告某处。
options.feedback: 证据模糊,组长要求精确。

n5b.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n5b.line: Interesting. Compare the cost per customer between the two channels: how does each one measure up?
n5b.lineCn: 有意思。比较两个渠道的单个客户成本:每个渠道表现如何?

grammar.name: 限定词 each(逐个比较)
grammar.note: each one 在两者之间逐一衡量,强调个体对比,是数据讨论的常用限定。

options.text: Each digital customer costs us two thirds of what each print customer costs.
options.textCn: 每个数字渠道客户的花费,是每个印刷渠道客户的三分之二。
options.feedback: 成本对比精确,结论有力。

options.text: Every customer counts equally, regardless of which channel attracted them.
options.textCn: 每个客户都同样重要,不管来自哪个渠道。
options.feedback: 视角人文,但需数据支撑。

options.text: I have not calculated that yet. Both figures are still unknown to me.
options.textCn: 我还没算过。这两个数字我都还不知道。
options.feedback: 分析缺环,组长要求补齐。

n6.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n6.line: Vague recollections weaken your argument. Either retrieve the exact numbers, or admit the gap in your analysis.
n6.lineCn: 模糊的记忆会削弱你的论点。要么找出确切数字,要么承认分析中的缺口。

grammar.name: 限定词 either...or(二选一)
grammar.note: either...or 给出两条路径,限定选择范围,语气正式且有压力。

options.text: I will pull up the exact numbers now. All the details are in the appendix.
options.textCn: 我现在就调出确切数字。全部细节都在附录里。

options.text: I admit the gap, but it will not change the overall picture.
options.textCn: 我承认有缺口,但这不会改变整体结论。
options.feedback: 坦诚但欠严谨,组长审视。

options.text: I do not need exact numbers. My instincts have never failed me.
options.textCn: 我不需要确切数字,我的直觉从没骗过我。
options.feedback: 靠直觉决策,团队不认可。

n7.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n7.line: Scepticism is healthy, but it must be backed by method. Neither of us can persuade the board with guesses.
n7.lineCn: 怀疑精神是健康的,但必须有方法支撑。我们谁都无法用猜测说服董事会。

grammar.name: 限定词 neither
grammar.note: neither of us 表"两者都不",强调无人例外,与否定句配合使用。

options.text: Agreed. Let me re-run the analysis with fresh data, and I will show you all the evidence.
options.textCn: 同意。让我用新数据重跑分析,并把全部证据展示给您。

options.text: Few people can resist my intuition. I will convince the board with passion alone.
options.textCn: 很少人能抵挡我的直觉。我单靠热情就能说服董事会。

options.text: Let us ask another team to review the data. Both sides can learn from that.
options.textCn: 让另一个团队复核数据吧,双方都能从中受益。

n8.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n8.line: Now we are getting somewhere. If both channels performed well, why cut print advertising completely?
n8.lineCn: 现在有点进展了。如果两个渠道都表现不错,为什么要完全砍掉印刷广告?

grammar.name: 限定词 both
grammar.note: both channels 表"两者都",用于概括双方表现,引出针对性疑问。

options.text: Because neither the reach nor the cost of print justifies keeping it.
options.textCn: 因为印刷广告的触达和成本,两者都不足以支持保留它。

options.text: We are not cutting it completely. Each channel will receive some share of the budget.
options.textCn: 我们不是完全砍掉。每个渠道都会分到部分预算。

options.text: Honestly, I dislike print ads, and personal preference colours my reading of the data.
options.textCn: 说实话,我不喜欢印刷广告,个人偏好影响了我的数据解读。
options.feedback: 承认主观偏差,组长批评。

n8b.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n8b.line: Then what about the long term? Either you show me two quarters of data, or I will reserve judgement.
n8b.lineCn: 那长期效果呢?要么你拿出两个季度的数据,要么我先保留判断。

grammar.name: 限定词 either...or(期限)
grammar.note: either...or 给出验收条件,限定时间范围与证据要求,谈判感强。

options.text: Either we wait for two more quarters, or we proceed with the evidence we have.
options.textCn: 要么再等两个季度,要么按现有证据推进。

options.text: Neither quarter is fully reliable, but the trend is too strong to ignore.
options.textCn: 两个季度都不完全可靠,但趋势强到不容忽视。

options.text: Long-term data is a luxury we cannot afford. Any delay costs us market share.
options.textCn: 长期数据是我们负担不起的奢侈品。任何拖延都在消耗市场份额。

n9.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n9.line: One last challenge: the more money we spend on digital ads, the harder it is to prove returns. How do you answer that?
n9.lineCn: 最后一个挑战:我们在数字广告上花的钱越多,越难证明回报。你怎么回应?

grammar.name: 限定词比较结构 the more...the more
grammar.note: the more A, the more B 构成比例句式,用于阐述投入与回报的动态关系。

options.text: The more data we collect, the more accurate our measurement will become.
options.textCn: 我们收集的数据越多,测量就会越精确。
options.feedback: 以数据规模回应,逻辑闭环。

options.text: That is precisely why I propose spending less overall and measuring more carefully.
options.textCn: 这正是我建议总体少花钱、测量更精细的原因。

options.text: If the board worries about returns, then spend nothing at all. Every risk disappears.
options.textCn: 董事会若担心回报,那就一分钱别花。所有风险都消失了。

n10.speaker: 组长 Sarah
n10.line: Your reasoning holds together. In that case, I will present your proposal at the board meeting. I believe all of us can now agree on this direction.
n10.lineCn: 你的推理自洽。这样的话,我会在董事会上提交你的方案。我相信我们所有人现在都能认同这个方向。

grammar.name: 限定词 all(全体)
grammar.note: all of us 表"我们全体",用于达成共识时的群体指称,语气郑重。

options.text: Thank you. All of us can now agree on this direction.
options.textCn: 谢谢。我们所有人现在都能认同这个方向。

options.text: Present my proposal, but remember: neither you nor I should overstate the certainty.
options.textCn: 请提交我的方案,但要记住:您和我都不应夸大确定性。

options.text: Forget presenting. I am not convinced by my own analysis either.
options.textCn: 别提交了。连我自己都不信自己的分析。

success.speaker: 组长 Sarah
success.line: The meeting is concluded. Both your analysis and your persistence have won the day.
success.lineCn: 会议结束。你的分析和你的坚持都赢得了这一天。

fail1.speaker: 组长 Sarah
fail1.line: Without solid data, your argument remains a castle in the air. I cannot support it.
fail1.lineCn: 没有扎实的数据,你的论证就是空中楼阁。我无法支持它。

fail2.speaker: 组长 Sarah
fail2.line: I appreciate your effort, but passion without evidence convinces no one on this team.
fail2.lineCn: 我感谢你的付出,但没有证据的热情说服不了团队里的任何人。
